run_mae_pretraining: run MAE pre-training on ImageNet with configurable batch size, epochs, and masking ratio
run_mae_pretraining_xla: run MAE pre-training on TPU devices using PyTorch XLA distributed multiprocessing
run_mae_pretraining_resume: resume MAE pre-training from a saved checkpoint with optimizer and loss scaler state
run_mae_pretraining_custom_model: run MAE pre-training with a custom ViT model variant and decoder configuration
run_mae_pretraining_distributed: run distributed MAE pre-training across multiple GPUs with gradient accumulation
